'''Bal Rado''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Drug dealer|dealer]] who was hired by the gangster [[Sol Proofrock]] to bring him some spices. He was killed by his partner [[Droo Wabbin]], when he lost the spices.
